versions.text: Criterion: Verify that flying qualities have been defined and assessed for safety of flight for all Air Vehicle States (6.1.1.3 and subparagraphs) encountered in the Flight Phases and tasks (6.1.1.2) of the operational missions (6.1.1.1). Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.1 Primary requirements. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets the standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.1 General. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, simulation, and inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
